content.short: Hord provides simple and secure liquid ETH staking.
content.description: Hord is a liquid ETH staking protocol developed by DcentraLab. It enables users to stake their ETH and receive hETH, a liquid token that represents their staked ETH along with accrued rewards. By turning staking into a liquid asset, Hord provides liquidity and flexibility, allowing users to trade or use hETH in DeFi while still earning staking rewards. This approach preserves staking yields while unlocking on-chain liquidity for additional activities.
